data.title: Choose the sentence that uses the word correctly.

sections.title: nine
sections.summary: the number 9; one more than eight

senses.definition: the number 9; one more than eight
examples: She has nine books on her shelf at home.
He counts nine birds on the roof.

answers.answer: She has nine books on her shelf at home.
There are nine days in a week.
Nine comes after ten when you count.
Four plus six equals nine.

examples: She scores ninety marks out of one hundred in the test.
A football match lasts ninety minutes.

answers.answer: She scores ninety marks out of one hundred in the test.
Ninety comes before eighty when you count.
Forty plus forty equals ninety.
Nine times eleven equals ninety.

sections.title: nine hundred and ninety-nine
sections.summary: the number 999; one less than one thousand

senses.definition: the number 999; one less than one thousand
examples: The online store has nine hundred and ninety-nine products to choose from.
She counts nine hundred and ninety-nine steps to the top of the hill.

answers.answer: The online store has nine hundred and ninety-nine products to choose from.
Nine hundred and ninety-nine is the same as one thousand.
Nine hundred plus ninety equals nine hundred and ninety-nine.
Nine hundred and ninety-nine comes after one thousand when you count.

sections.title: ten
sections.summary: the number 10; one more than nine

senses.definition: the number 10; one more than nine
examples: There are ten fingers on two hands.
She counts to ten before starting the game.

answers.answer: There are ten fingers on two hands.
A week has ten days.
Ten comes after eleven when you count.
Five plus six equals ten.

sections.title: one
sections.summary: the number 1; a single unit or thing

senses.definition: the number 1; a single unit or thing
examples: She eats one apple and one banana for lunch.
He has one brother and two sisters.

answers.answer: She eats one apple and one banana for lunch.
There is one day in a week.
One comes after two when you count.
Zero plus zero equals one.
